title: Unconditional time lower bounds for Weisfeiler–Leman equivalence
main_claim: There are absolute constants c>0 and k_0 such that for every fixed k≥k_0, any correct deterministic decider for k-WL equivalence (joint or separate convention) runs in time T_A(n) ≥ n^{ck} for all n ≥ n_0(A,k). This holds for multitape TMs and log-word RAMs, with explicit adjacency matrices, and even under the promise that inputs are simple connected uncolored graphs of diameter ≤2.
coverage: I read all five sections of the LaTeX in full and checked each step of the proof chain. (1) Game ↔ WL (Lemma 1.2): joint convention K=k+1, separate K=k. Checked both directions and the successive-bijection argument for histograms. (2) Compressed reduction (Thm 2.2), the novel part: - Necessity: transporting a site-ring sum through squares stays within r+1 pairs; the vertical readouts at boundary i are shared by the squares in rows i−1 and i, so they cancel, and the affine link equation comes from δ_r. The Q sets defined by attainability give both inclusions. - Support-tree lemma: a wire has 4(r+1)+1 links, which is more than r+1. - Wrapping/address lemma: same horizontal parity in every row, label parity at each boundary, and agreement between size-r subcollections (uses r≥3). - Exact projection: went through each shift-restriction case (real/real, interior, arm reaching a real endpoint through σ) and the potential adjustment M'_v = M_v + s_v g_t. Recomputed that horizontal and vertical readouts are unchanged. - Translation strategy: offsets preserve adjacency. - Uncolored version: degree intervals for the marks and hub; counted O(m^2) blocks and O(m^6) vertices. (3) Circuit simulation (Prop 3.1): checked the buffer table B_D and that tests being terminal is what makes it work. Product-schema carry/borrow decompositions, seed/test domains, the ring-injectivity slack and acyclicity are all correct. (4) Diagonal language H_s: the every-length lower bound via padded self-designation, and the polynomial upper bound for M_s. (5) Transfer: checked the exponent arithmetic. 20s
sibling_notes: The family 133 board was empty when I started, so there were no sibling reports to cross-check. The paper is self-contained: it proves its own game correspondence and compression lemmas and does not rely on companion papers for any step of the main proof.
